scope: Static lossless freight between declared local stock accounts in one selected capacity period.
inputs: finite dated transport and crew budgets
host-selected routes, access limits and allocation order
procedure: Allocate source-stock claims through the shared finite allocator. Mirror only new actual fulfillment into same-resource, same-unit destination imports. Keep exact paired posting references.
invariants: total source debit equals total destination credit
shared transport and crew capacity deducted once
no destination output from requested or prior fulfilled quantities
review_route: SV arithmetic and interface inspection; independent agent review deferred
limits: Not empirical transport performance or a reviewed source-corpus formula
Same stock unit and quantum at each endpoint; no loss, conversion or automatic recycling
No same-pass transshipment or coupled route solver
All routes compete through an explicit host-selected procedure
Destination overflow rejects the entire candidate
Missing routes reject the request; zero throughput and denied access retain unmet claims
No automatic model activation, public IPC, renderer integration or persistence
No transition, calendar advancement or stochastic behavior
next_task: Integrate reviewed production/use definitions and guarded options, then run actual paired-domain acceptance. DOM-01 static and WP-032 remain open.
